review:
A no-fuss wilderness Megaways game. With up to eight rows on each reel, the ways count goes even beyond the usual 117,649, and wins tumble away for chains.

The free spins bring wild multipliers and are easy to retrigger. It doesn't do anything surprising, but it's a solid, reliable example of a Megaways tumble slot. High volatility, 5,000x max, 96.52% RTP.
